description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-08-05 and again when the earlier Golden Coast phases reached main, so those lists only contain exact reviewed deltas since that snapshot: the three Phase 7 sales-cash-transfer middleware mounts introduced by the Phase 16 HADI transfer guard, the four POS inventory-cost boundary mounts introduced by #1279, and the second DELETE /api/vouchers/:id registration that #1206 mounts ahead of the generic voucher delete so Golden Coast POS cash settlements cascade correctly. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The source-text allowance covers assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records, led by the #1193 entry in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression. The three #1196 assertions in tests/supplier-partner-net-position-inclusion.test.ts that this file used to carry were removed by #1200, so the ceiling drops with them.
